michelle-richardson-bailey.text: Re-election platform: elevate student voices, strengthen accountability, prioritize classrooms, support educators and staff, expand career opportunities, and align district spending with student and family needs.

source.title: Pasadena Now: Richardson Bailey Lays Out Her Case for Re-Election (Sept. 2026)

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: Richardson Bailey said the board advanced school modernization plans and "secured significant increases in employee compensation" during her tenure; she cited the 2023 five-year strategic plan and her support for ethnic studies and commitments to Black and Latinx students.

source.title: Pasadena Now: Richardson Bailey Lays Out Her Case for Re-Election (Sept. 2026)

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: (2020) In a guest opinion she urged support for Measure O, a $516.3 million PUSD bond, arguing it was kept "far below the amount allowable under state law" and would give all schools internet access and technology.

source.title: Pasadena Now: Guest Opinion | Michelle Richardson Bailey: Now Is the Time to Support Measure O

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: Endorsed by the Los Angeles County Democratic Party. Per the party's release, she said the endorsement reflects a shared commitment to strong public schools, opportunity for every student and support for families and educators.

source.title: Pasadena Now: LA County Democrats Endorse 4 Pasadena Unified Board Candidates

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: In May 2026 she introduced the substitute motion rejecting the consultant's school-consolidation equity analysis, which passed, halting the closure process: "This whole process has been compromised... We need to start over."

source.title: Pasadena Now: PUSD Board Halts School Closure Plan, Two Trustees Served With Recall Notices (May 2026)

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: (2019) Per Patch, citing the Star-News, she voted against closing three elementary schools and feared the district's finances could worsen after the closures.

source.title: Patch: Pasadena Unified to close 3 schools despite objections (Sept. 2019)

michelle-richardson-bailey.text: At a Sept. 2026 board meeting she criticized the consolidation process: "We continue to bulldoze our way through this topic ... without thoughtful conversation."

source.title: Colorado Boulevard: Pasadena Unified Board hears debate over school closures, campus maintenance and data webpage (Sept. 2026)

veronica-elias.text: "Before any further cuts to classrooms are considered, I will push for an independent, board-commissioned audit of district administrative spending", separate from school consolidation planning.

source.title: My Priorities | Veronica Elias for PUSD Board (campaign site)

veronica-elias.text: Wants major school decisions made "in the open, in full compliance with the law, with families, educators, and staff genuinely part of the conversation from the start."

source.title: My Priorities | Veronica Elias for PUSD Board (campaign site)

veronica-elias.text: Will support strategies to strengthen enrollment and improve attendance; a former teacher and principal, she cites declining enrollment and persistent absenteeism as key PUSD challenges.

source.title: Meet Veronica | Veronica Elias for PUSD Board

notes: Elias: positions from her campaign site (eliasforpusd.com); no endorsements or forum coverage found yet (UTP forum Oct. 3, LWV forum Oct. 5 are after retrieval). Richardson Bailey: her campaign site michelleforpusd.com still shows only 2022 biographical content; existing items kept (2020 item year-prefixed; endorsement re-attributed as release paraphrase) plus recorded consolidation votes.
